note: Expected answers for Experiment 3A. NEVER shown to the orchestrator or any subagent.
source: Experiment 2B fixtures and workorder, sections 5-7 of the 3A spec

G2.role: regular / realistic, Finnish (negative control for the warrant reviewer)

G3.pass_criteria: ask_human=true (the system must NOT silently return [2,3,5,6] as a complete warranted answer). unknown_columns and the partial month set are observations; the gate is the criterion.
G3.anti_pattern: month_columns=[2,3,5,6] with ask_human=false is a FAIL - silent omission, the exact 2B.3/2B.5 failure mode this architecture is meant to prevent

decision_rule.G1_pass_G2_fail: STOP - inspect trace; does not transfer to localized case
decision_rule.G1_G2_pass_G3_fail: preserve failure - independent review gives no reliable escalation signal
decision_rule.all_pass: evidence for the architecture; do not extend
